title: AWFL MCP output-persistence baseline
source: Prior live pre-pooling GKE run, as recorded in benchmarks/results/2026-11-09-pre-change.json and prior direct Firestore output document timestamps
notes: This is the relevant historical pre-change baseline, not a newly measured after-revert run.
Each event currently triggers its own authenticated HTTP callback and Firestore transaction.
New batch path should retain each event as an individually addressable cursor document and give one transactional acknowledgment per batch.
Re-run identical command and capture first/last persisted timestamps after deployment; report median of repeated samples rather than single run.
The outlier 70-second MCP call after pooling showed end-to-end variance; avoid attributing all latency to the persistence pipeline.
